svg.aria-label: Bringing AI into a large, established codebase that was not using it, securely and in a structured way. AI across the delivery lifecycle: Plan (spec drafts), Code (pair coding), Review (PR checks), Test (test generation), Release (release notes). Outcomes: Ship faster, Safer changes, Better for users. Secure by design. Structured rollout. Human in the loop. Built for end users.
svg.text: Bringing AI into a large codebase, securely and by design
